tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Search real for-sale homes on Enzo's by plain language, architectural style, features, budget, beds/baths, and location (metro or neighborhood). Returns matching homes with price, style, and a link to the original source listing. Use for questions like 'spanish revival homes with a pool under $1.5M

tools.name: below_market_deals
tools.description: List homes currently priced BELOW comparable homes (a good-value / below-market signal) in a given metro, newest-best first. Input is a metro or city name.

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.description: A live snapshot of a US metro's for-sale market on Enzo's: how many homes are for sale, the price range (5th percentile, median, 95th percentile) and the most common architectural styles. Input is a metro or city name, e.g. 'Austin, TX'.

tools.name: video_tours
tools.description: List for-sale homes that have a real agent-filmed video walkthrough (TikTok), which the big listing portals do not carry. Optionally filter to a metro or state.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: home_verdict, get_home · Public sink: home_verdict.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: home_verdict, get_home · Public sink: home_verdict

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
